mapper.sql: t.id, t.user_id, t.clause, t.reason, t.listed_at, t.expire_at, t.notify_time, t.status, t.operator_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, DATEDIFF(t.expire_at, CURDATE()) AS days_left
FROM volunteer_blacklist t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = t.user_id AND sp.deleted = 0

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_blacklist (user_id, clause, reason, listed_at, expire_at, notify_time, status, operator_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{clause}, #{reason}, #{listedAt}, #{expireAt}, #{notifyTime}, #{status}, #{operatorId}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status = 'active' AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_blacklist SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_blacklist t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = #{status}
SELECT t.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM volunteer_blacklist t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY t.status
